bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 142 (Thursday, September 12, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. NADLER:
H.R. 9573.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, clause 18
The single subject of this legislation is:
Environment
[Page H5231]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on Transportation and Infrastructure, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
